label: run-06
method: Identical to runs 01 to 05. One agent per shard of 25 questions, 19 shards, dispatched from runs/prompt.md verbatim with only the shard path and output path substituted. Each agent was given the question ids and text only, plus the path to R9_1_GX_CLI_Reference/, and was forbidden to read anything under tools/. Sixteen dispatched first and the last three as slots freed, to stay inside the 20-agent concurrency cap.
corpus_note: First run to record its own index digest, in corpus.json, written by prepare_run.py --collect rather than typed by hand. Runs 01 to 05 predate that and cannot be backfilled without an old checkout.
purpose: Falsification of three changes that were all made against runs 01 to 05 and so could not be checked by them: the Containment section in entities.md, the certificate fact sweep, and the card-type re-encoding on multi-controller-card-vs-card. An edit fitted to the stored runs would pass those runs by construction; only a new run can say anything.
result_note: All three survived. multi-ipsec-policy-nesting passes, taking the post-containment record to 2 of 2 against 1 of 4 before it, which is the first evidence for that section from answers it was not fitted to. All eight edited certificate tests pass, as does multi-controller-card-vs-card on card-type and multi-certificate-role-disambiguation, which the sweep deliberately left alone. Note what this does and does not show: an edit that merely made a test easier would also pass here. The justification for each edit was that the question demanded it, and that argument was made before this run existed.
score_note: Scored against the tests at the commit the answers were produced at. Compare with the other runs only via compare_runs.py, which rescores every stored run against the working tree.
dispatch_note: No shard failed. Shards 01 and 02 are entirely multi-command questions, the shape that produced the delegate-and-return-nothing failure in run 03 and twice in run 05; both completed normally here, at 98 and 96 tool calls over about nine minutes each, against the roughly 12 calls and two minutes that failure takes. Every answer file was verified present on disk with matching ids before collecting. Shard 02 reported writing two staging files to the session scratchpad, outside the project, which do not enter the run. Its answers run longer than the 400-800 asked for, but the run mean is 817 characters, in line with 810, 816, 821, 830 and 819 for runs 01 to 05, so the method held.
defects_note: Agents reported source defects already on the known list in ../../README.md: eccp251, failk, the supported-gain-range carried-over row, can-be-cleared-by-user, aaa-server shared-secret, sc-rx/sc-tx, key-replacement-package, eth-zr thresholds. Three candidates not obviously on it and not yet verified: carrier-neighbor describing age as a hardware version, fiber-connection's worked example not matching its parameter list, and card documenting alarm-report-control as defaulting to Inhibited where the facility pages default to allowed.
